title: Add behaviour tests for settlement_read_failed and the recovery worker-join and pending-write decisions
outcome: The remaining typed causal recovery outcomes have behaviour tests through the real worker: settlement_read_failed on the original row, and the admission_worker_or_pending_write_failed and worker_join_failed counts in causalCompletionReady.decisions.
acceptance: A test refuses the settlement read after a completion is delivered (for example with a disposable-store fault) and asserts that the original row shows settlement_read_failed with release condition original_settlement_read_succeeds.
A test refuses the worker's pending-state write after settlement and asserts decisions.admission_worker_or_pending_write_failed is 1.
A test makes the recovery worker fail to join and asserts decisions.worker_join_failed is 1; no test asserts log text or timing.
